name: r2t4
diagnosis: Dominant policy-induced failures isolate the first mild friction wheel (severity 0.2, residual ~4.6e-04 Nm just above 0.0003) consuming the one-isolation budget, leaving a later severe friction/derate wheel in control. 4-wheel allocation without policy rides through, but 3-wheel control with the bad wheel fails.
rationale: Increase FDIR persistence 3 to 4 consecutive 5s hits. Requires sustained residual, filtering intermittent marginal exceedances from mild Coulomb friction when commanded torque varies, while still isolating solid dead-wheel faults whose residual equals command and persists. Only 5s delay, no threshold or SAFE-logic change.
why_no_regressions: Only delays isolation by 5s, preserves isolation order and decisions for persistent faults, adds no new SAFE triggers or swaps. Negligible versus 60s saturation and 1200s attitude-loss thresholds.
gate_reason: rejected (strict): 3 new violations in 3 runs (3 previously clean), 0 fixes, evaluation stopped early after 13 runs
